Chinese Coast Guard vessel collides with Philippine boat

A Chinese Coast Guard vessel collided with a Philippine boat in the South China Sea, leading to a diplomatic dispute. The incident involved a cargo ship weighing 82,000 tons ramming a Chinese fishing boat, according to one report. The collision has sparked a diplomatic clash.
